---
title: "Migrating from 1.x to 2.0"
---

metrosp 2.0 renames most datasets, several columns, and the cache helpers.
The tables below map each 1.x name to its 2.0 name. See the
[changelog](../news/index.html) for the reasons behind each change.

## Datasets

| 1.x | 2.0 |
|---|---|
| `passengers_entrance` | `line_entries_monthly` |
| `passengers_transported` | `line_transported_monthly` |
| `station_averages` | `station_transported_monthly` |
| `station_daily` | `station_entries_daily` |
| `lines` | `rail_lines` |
| `stations` | `rail_stations` |
| `station_inauguration` | Removed |

`calendar_spo` and `metro_colors` keep their names.

## Columns

| 1.x | 2.0 | Datasets |
|---|---|---|
| `metric_abb` | `metric` | Demand datasets |
| `metric` | `metric_name` | Demand datasets |
| `metric_pt` | `metric_name_pt` | Demand datasets |
| `passengers`, `avg_passenger` | `value` | Demand datasets |
| `is_ponto_facultativo` | `is_optional_holiday` | `calendar_spo` |
| `is_feriadao` | `is_long_weekend` | `calendar_spo` |

The station datasets and `rail_stations` now have `station_id`, a stable,
opaque identifier shared by members of the same physical station complex.
Keep `station_name` for display. Grouping `station_transported_monthly` by
`station_id` adds boardings across its platforms, not unique entrants.
`station_transported_monthly` also has `metric = "mdu"`, `metric_name`, and
`metric_name_pt`; `station_entries_daily` has no metric columns. The `year`
and `line_number` columns are integers in the demand datasets.

`metric` changed meaning: it held the English label in 1.x and holds the
short code (`total`, `mdu`, ...) in 2.0. Code that filters on `metric` needs
the new codes.

## Functions

| 1.x | 2.0 |
|---|---|
| `metrosp_cache_dir()` | `metrosp_cache()` |
| `metrosp_cache_list()` | `metrosp_cache()` |
| `metrosp_cache_enable()` | Removed; caching is on by default |

`read_metro_demand()` and `metrosp_cache_clear()` keep their names.
`metrosp_cache()` lists cached files and prints the cache location; it does
not return only a directory path. Use `attr(metrosp_cache(), "directory")` to
get that path. Set `cache = FALSE` on a read to use
session-temporary storage. Version 2.1 also adds `read_metro_service()` for
`line_service_monthly`.

## Values

- `line_transported_monthly$value` now counts passengers, not thousands.
  Drop any `* 1000` your code applied.
- The `line_number == 99` network rows are gone, with no replacement.

## Example

```r
# 1.x
passengers_entrance |>
  dplyr::filter(metric_abb == "total") |>
  dplyr::select(date, line_number, passengers)

# 2.0
line_entries_monthly |>
  dplyr::filter(metric == "total") |>
  dplyr::select(date, line_number, value)
```
